code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (pH 6.8, low O2 saturation/PaO2), anemia (low Hb, MCV), leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin, LDH, D-dimer). There is also mild hypoalbuminemia and hypoproteinemia. Findings suggest severe respiratory failure with systemic inflammation, possible sepsis or multi-organ dysfunction, and high risk of coagulopathy. Immediate clinical intervention is warranted.
